name: DefectDojo
description: DefectDojo is an open-source vulnerability management tool that streamlines the testing process by offering features such as importing third party security tools results, merging and de-duplication, integration with Jira, dynamic risk acceptance, false positive management, workflows for multiple business units and more.

environment.name: HOST
environment.description: The base URL of your DefectDojo instance (e.g. https://defectdojo.example.com).

environment.name: API_KEY
environment.description: Your DefectDojo API key. Retrieve it from your profile page at <host>/api/key-v2.
